title: Learning boogie woogie, trying guitar and sticking with piano
summary: He learned boogie woogie quickly, argues that you can learn music by playing, tried guitar and other instruments around 1934-35, and returned to piano.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught
